name: SQL Basics
description: Ask a database questions, from one table to several joined together.

lessonNames.l8-daily-volume: Daily volume from a trades table

lessonObjectives.l1-choosing-columns: Select columns from a table and rename them.
lessonObjectives.l2-filtering-rows: Filter rows with `WHERE` and combine conditions.
lessonObjectives.l3-top-ten: Sort results and keep only the first few.
lessonObjectives.l4-missing-values: Handle `NULL` correctly in conditions and counts.
lessonObjectives.l5-counting-and-averaging: Use `COUNT`, `SUM` and `AVG` on a whole table.
lessonObjectives.l6-per-group: Group rows and aggregate each group.
lessonObjectives.l7-filtering-groups: Filter groups with `HAVING`, and see why `WHERE` cannot do it.
lessonObjectives.l8-daily-volume: Summarise a trades table by day and symbol.
lessonObjectives.l9-keys: Explain how keys link two tables.
lessonObjectives.l10-matching-rows: Join two tables with an inner join.
lessonObjectives.l11-no-match: Use a left join to find rows with no partner.
lessonObjectives.l12-database-to-pandas: Query SQLite from Python into a DataFrame.
